label: Rec.709 / BT.1886 (display-referred video)

signal.notes: Nominal 0..1 Rec.709 signal as presented by the host (video levels 64-940 -> 0..1).

application: Footage recorded or already converted to Rec.709 (BT.709 primaries, viewed on a BT.1886 gamma 2.4 display). The LUT maps the image back to scene values through the inverse of the CINERA Neutral Rendering, applies the look and re-renders. A neutral look is an identity.
